messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — I want to unpin runtime 2.14.1 from the default pinlist so the canary can pick up 2.14.2 with the quant-pack fix. Target window: today 15:00-16:00 PT.
alex: Are we confident 2.14.2 is compatible with llama3q long-seq? any known KV cache changes?
kevin: The change is only kernel selection logic + a small kv-cache pointer fix, should be fine. Still want a short canary (10%) and smoke tests.
maria: I can run the QA suite during the window. I need the exact pinlist path to update and the rollback command if things go sideways.
jamie: Pinlist is at repo:infra/pinlists/runtime-default.json. Plan: remove "2.14.1" entry and let deploybot pick 2.14.2 as primary for canary.
shawn: Agree on smoke + perf. Define SLO triggers: if p95 latency increases > 15% or error rate > 0.8% across canary -> rollback.
kevin: Add another quick safety check: model mismatch errors in logs ("kv_cache_mismatch" or "unrecognized_kernel") should be immediate rollback.
maria: Command I'll run to update (local):
```bash
git checkout -b unpin-runtime-2-14-1
# edit infra/pinlists/runtime-default.json
git commit -am "unpin runtime 2.14.1 for canary 2.14.2"
git push && phabricator create review
```
alex: +1. Also let's update the rollout flags to 10% canary and 30 minute observation window.
jamie: deploy-bot, schedule unpin for 2026-04-02T22:00Z (15:00 PT) with canary 10% and auto-checks.
deploy-bot: [scheduled] Action: pinlist-update queued by jamie for 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z. Rollout policy: canary=10%, observe=30m, rollback-on:latency>15%|error_rate>0.8%|kv_cache_mismatch. Request ID: rb-216789.
oncall-bot: @oncall assigned: alex. Please monitor canary.
shawn: I'll tail canary logs and post a short summary at +10m and +30m.
maria: Starting deploy in 5. Applying patch to pinlist now.
deploy-bot: [info] Applying pinlist patch rb-216789 to infra/pinlists/runtime-default.json.
maria: Patch merged. Deploy started.
shawn: Seeing an uptick in p95 on canary nodes, from 210ms -> 245ms at +8m (≈17%). Flagging.
alex: That crosses the threshold. Shawn, start rollback.
shawn: Rolling back now. Command used: `deployctl rollout --service=runtime --from=2.14.2 --to=2.14.1 --canary=100% --force`
deploy-bot: [deploy] Rollback started (rb-216789). Target runtime: 2.14.1 -> applying to canary then rest. ETA ~ 4m.
maria: Smoke tests post-rollback are clean so far. No model errors in logs.
kevin: Thanks all. We should file a follow-up to inspect the perf regression. Likely kernel selection path needs a guard.
jamie: Agreed. Action items: (1) revert unpin (pin 2.14.1) — done by rollback, (2) create an eval job comparing selection paths, (3) re-run canary after kernel guard is added.
alex: I'll own the evaluation ticket.
maria: Closing out from QA — will re-run after kevin's patch. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [complete] Rollback rb-216789 finished. Status: success. All nodes reporting runtime 2.14.1.
jamie: Thanks everyone. Good catch on the latency signal. We'll schedule a guarded reattempt after fixes.
__note: This document is a single Slack thread. Messages are chronological, prefixed with sender names. No title field per agents.md rules.
